shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
horizontal bands or registers dividing the surface
small repeated schematic motifs incised into the surface
justification: Both are weathered stone surfaces bearing shallow relief carving that includes human figures, discs and horizontally banded divisions, and both use small schematic motifs repeated across the field. But A is a massive three-dimensional frontal figure whose ornament follows the body (headdress, arms, pectoral disc), while B is a flat rectangular plaque dominated by dense ruled rows of tiny uniform signs with only two small kneeling figures in a bottom register — the compositional logic and scale of carving are quite unlike.
